regional_priority.description: Higher-signal European and Russian-adjacent hosting providers that are often useful in attribution-focused origin scans.

global_baseline.description: Broader global cloud, CDN, and VPS platforms that help separate likely origin infrastructure from common edge and commodity hosting noise.

edge_and_cdn_noise.description: Large edge platforms that may be useful to classify, but are often lower-signal for direct origin attribution.
